subject.name: Signal Dash experience authored fixture study 3

context.primary_job: inspect and manage dense technical work
context.applicability_boundary: Do not transfer product identity or patterns tied to unrelated workflows.

observations.observed_pattern: Neutral surfaces dominate while semantic accent is sparse.
observations.transferable_mechanism: Use semantic surface and action roles rather than copying exact colors.
observations.applicability_boundary: Applies to dense professional workspaces with comparable task frequency.

causality.note: The product's success does not prove this color treatment caused the success.
